improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it's for (trade and business). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a clear, low-friction CTA with the free trial offer. The name 'Gideon' is introduced naturally, building brand recognition without jargon.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day (billed monthly), giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—what happens at the paywall—while reinforcing value and clearly stating pricing. It reduces uncertainty for prospects deciding whether to try the free searches, knowing exactly what comes next.
